Use case: ui-mockup. Design a complete refined Chinese desktop companion app screen at 1536x1024, representing 1220x768 CSS pixels. The ONLY reference is the approved clean empty literary daylight room. It is a continuous lived-in environment, not a wallpaper boxed in a web dashboard. Preserve the room's warm wood, linen, window geometry, calm daylight and open right side. Do not draw any new person, cat, random avatar, macOS traffic lights or device border. The existing independently drawn character portrait will stay in the real app; this concept focuses on note interaction.

Keep the existing tiny transparent global nav: 在场 at top left, 聊天 今天 留下 centered, 留下 selected with a thin underline; a quiet search at top right. No wide top bar, no giant duplicated 留下 heading, no helper paragraph. This is the NOTES WRITING state inside 留下, not another application and not a file manager. A person is shaping one thought, can return to its original source, and can later discuss exactly one sentence. "Consistency is the key": one reading surface, one action anchor and one typography scale carry every state. No repetitive airplane/send icons on note controls, no toolbar cockpit, no far-away + button, no always-open search/index or trash/history panels.

Use original design-example text only: title “先把这一小步想明白”; body “我想先保留这个疑问，而不是把整页抄下来。\n\n把变化拆成两段以后，真正卡住的是第二个等号。等下回来，就从这里接着看。\n\n有时一句自己的话，比整理完整的结论更值得留下。” This sample is authored for UI exploration, not a claim about an actual user or file. A small source tab “原文 · 第3页” may appear only as a conceptual source relationship. Body is readable 16px CSS at 1.9 line-height, title 24px, controls 12–13px. Align title, source, body and footer to one left text baseline.

The writing surface is quiet matte warm flax/stone paper, distinct from bright white: approximately #e9decb with high enough opacity that the actual room's lines never show through text. Glass may occur in one small transient toolbar only. In rain-night the exact same layout uses smoke-tea paper and warm ivory text, not a huge cream slab. No whole-column scrim, no giant white rounded rectangle, no two nested bright input boxes, no torn-paper/leather texture and no green UI. The title is an editable page title, not a second form box: no large outline, no double focus border; a subtle thin underline/caret is enough when focused. Body has an insertion caret without an enclosing textarea frame.

Controls appear where their object is. A small back-to-留下 text/chevron, one notebook toggle and one ellipsis are grouped together at the current page. Only one small 保存 action is present while dirty. After true save it becomes a subdued check at exactly the same anchor; do not duplicate a success toast and receipt wall. Original note owner, revision history, recycle bin, source return and draft backup remain available through the object menu/drawer, not deleted or sprayed across the room. A selected sentence reveals a single small “接着这句” action next to the selection. Only the later conversation state has the ONE original shared composer, with a source chip and one send control; do not show another send icon in the notes form. No fake AI answer, no auto-save claim, no progress dashboard.
SELECTED DIRECTION A — NARROW RETURN TO THE SAME CONVERSATION, one complete near-square screen representing a760x768CSS desktop window. Keep the same folio width system and readable16CSSpx text; this is not a phone UI. Full-bleed room with no blank bands, unchanged transparent global nav at the top.
This is the naturally SCROLLED continuation state after the user selected one note sentence and opened discussion. No content has been deleted or shrunk to make it fit: the title and earlier paragraphs are above the current viewport, reachable by normal scrolling. Show a fine ordinary page scrollbar. Immediately below global nav, the selected original paragraph and end of the SAME note remain visible as a contextual paper fragment, with its saved check at the same local footer anchor. Highlight “真正卡住的是第二个等号。” A small source tag means the NOTE'S own sentence, never an invented PDF page.
Directly below this note fragment, the original conversation continues in ONE calm matte warm-flax panel, about x24..736,y260..720. It includes a small “这页的一句” note-reference chip, a short concrete proposed reply and the ONE original shared composer visibly complete at its bottom. The unsent current draft is “想从这里再看一步。”. Keep source remove and one send control usable. A single close x folds discussion and restores the note's exact selection/scroll/focus. There is no second composer, separate chat page, extra top title, category list, stretched room, or huge empty input. This frame shows ordinary scrolling/reveal bringing the original input into view, not absolute-positioning the input over the note.
